from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PrincipalsSyncedData:
    application_code: str
    created: int
    deactivated: int
    synced_emails: list[str]
    updated: int

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> PrincipalsSyncedData:
        return cls(
            application_code=data.get("applicationCode"),
            created=data.get("created"),
            deactivated=data.get("deactivated"),
            synced_emails=data.get("syncedEmails"),
            updated=data.get("updated"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "applicationCode": self.application_code,
            "created": self.created,
            "deactivated": self.deactivated,
            "syncedEmails": self.synced_emails,
            "updated": self.updated,
        }
